name: codex-usage
description: Show live permissions, context, and usage limits in the Codex CLI footer.

interface.shortDescription: Live usage and context in the CLI footer.
interface.longDescription: Configures the native Codex CLI status line to show permissions, context remaining, context window size, and the current five-hour and weekly usage limits.
defaultPrompt: Configure my live Codex usage footer.
Remove the Codex usage footer and restore my prior setting.
